_about: Ticket 21, the free-shipping promotion on ReelFlies_CA (BUILD-1; ticket 13 decision 2): free standard shipping in Canada on fly orders over CAD $60, fly boxes and gear not included. It names channel 1895766 and currency CAD, because an empty channels list reaches every channel and currency '*' also discounts .com (ticket 03 item 7). Promotions are Shaun's: plan.mjs --approved, then apply.mjs --approved at his terminal. The ELIGIBLE and APPLIED wording is DRAFT copy for his approval; the UPSELL line is ticket 13's default.
_waiting: Not plannable yet, so the request sits under draft_requests, which plan.mjs never reads: plan.mjs refuses this file ('a plan needs 1 to 50 requests') before it reads a token or the store. rules[0].condition.cart.items.categories waits for the tree-4 Fly Type ids (refactor 13), and rules[0].action.shipping.zone_ids for the Canada shipping zone's id, which the read-only account can't read (no Store logistics scope): Shaun gives it, or a read with that scope. When both are filled, rename draft_requests to requests and remove this key; the tests then require both ids.
